notes.title: SLAIN IS BACK - Slain 2: The Beast Within
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585337/e1044c10c91657f83949e571a011f08ecab9888c.png
Steel Mantis and Silver Lining Interactive are back to deliver a blood-soaked, pixel-art action platformer like never before!

After the massive success of Slain: Back From Hell, Slain 2:The Beast within returns with the same ferocious, fast-paced combat and brutal challenge that fans loved, but this time, it’s set in an all-new, darker fantasy world. The moon is rising, the blood is flowing, and the hunt begins - are you ready to answer its call?

What's back and better than ever!

Ferocious Hack-and-Slash Combat 
The signature, fast, satisfying melee combat returns, with even more brutal ways to cleave through enemies.

Bathoryn is BACK 
Bathoryn returns as a sentient sword, now in your hands. The deadly blade is ready to unleash its elemental fury to tear through hordes of monstrous enemies. 

What new can you expect?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585337/a2570878192fee6ed92dbbca373f26e5f828fd60.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585337/083fff5d2bf7ead2a52145b34eaf804b1f7eea31.png
Prince Akran, the last of the cursed Wolf Knights is on a quest to save the world as he knows it. Transform into a savage werewolf under the full moon, and unleash unimaginable speed and power on your enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585337/cc8c55ceac1f18cd63076871f00374fa30d158c7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585337/264a10545106378c2074d21cf1fe2e6f7fa808d2.png
Embark on three unique, perilous quests - each filled with challenging enemies, deep lore, and epic battles against impossible odds. Sacrifices must be made, and your strength will be tested like never before.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585337/a8d1ee4d3bbf6c22b14dd8db55a0d999bfa2e56f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585337/34c383932646329ccb1e88f6294a17747e00a5c1.png
From the very first moments of the game, you’ll feel the grim weight of the world around you. Your path will be treacherous, but the thrill of combat and the lure of Bathoryn’s power will keep you pushing forward.

What are you waiting for? Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3601680/Slain_2_The_Beast_Within/
